dashboard.title: Linked numbers
dashboard.unlinkConfirmBody: This logs the device out of WhatsApp and removes its cached groups. Past scheduled messages and send logs are kept for your records.
dashboard.onboardingSubtitle: Four steps from a fresh number to a message on autopilot.
dashboard.step1Body: Give it a label and add it below — each number gets its own isolated WhatsApp session.
dashboard.step2Body: Link it with a QR code or a phone-number pairing code, whichever's easier.
dashboard.step3Body: Pick the WhatsApp groups to send to — individual contacts are never an option.
dashboard.step4Body: Write your message, set a time (or a recurrence), and Cronos sends it for you.
dashboard.featureGroupsOnlyBody: No accidental DMs — the schema itself only allows group targets.
dashboard.featureReliableBody: Jobs survive restarts and reconnect automatically if a session drops.
dashboard.featureMultiNumberBody: Link as many WhatsApp numbers as you manage, each independent.

landing.heroBody: Connect your number, pick the groups, and let Cronos deliver — once, weekly, or daily. No spreadsheets, no copy-pasting.
landing.stepsSubtitle: After that Cronos works on its own — and tells you when something fails.
landing.step1Title: Scan the QR and you're set
landing.step1Body: One isolated session per number, with live status. Link as many numbers as you manage on the same account.
landing.step2Body: Your WhatsApp groups sync automatically with member counts — individual contacts are never a target.
landing.step3Body: Reusable templates, attachments, daily or weekly recurrence, and per-group delivery history.
landing.finalBody: Your schedules keep running even after a restart.
landing.footerTagline: WhatsApp group messages, scheduled — not a single copy-paste.
